ya4.2.1:1.1: Yassa cakkhudhātu uppajjati, tassa sotadh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:2.1: Sacakkhukānaṃ asotakānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudh. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ sotadh. uppajjati; sacakkhukānaṃ sasotakānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ cakkhudh. ca uppajjati, sotadh. ca uppajjati.
ya4.2.1:3.1: Yassa vā pana sotadh. uppajjati, tassa cakkhudh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:4.1: Sasotakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotadh. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudh. uppajjati; sasotakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ sotadh. ca uppajjati, cakkhudh. ca uppajjati. (1-3.)
ya4.2.1:5.1: Yassa cakkhudh. uppajjati, tassa ghānadh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:10.1: Yassa vā pana rūpadh. uppajjati, tassa cakkhudh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:11.1: Sarūpakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpadh. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudh. uppajjati; sarūpakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ rūpadh. ca uppajjati, cakkhudh. ca uppajjati. (1-17.)
ya4.2.1:12.1: Yassa cakkhudh, uppajjati, tassa manoviññāṇadh. uppajjatīti? Āmantā.
ya4.2.1:13.1: Yassa vā pana manoviññāṇadh. uppajjati, tassa cakkhudh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:14.1: Sacittakānaṃ acakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manoviññāṇadh. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudh. uppajjati; sacittakānaṃ sacakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ manoviññāṇadh. ca uppajjati, cakkhudh. ca uppajjati. (1-8.)
ya4.2.1:15.1: Yassa cakkhudh. uppajjati, tassa dhammadh. uppajjatīti? Āmantā.
ya4.2.1:16.1: Yassa vā pana dhammadh. uppajjati, tassa cakkhudh. uppajjatīti?
ya4.2.1:17.1: Acakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammadh. uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cakkhudh. uppajjati, sacakkhukānaṃ uppajjantānaṃ tesaṃ dhammadh. ca uppajjati, cakkhudh. ca uppajjati.
ya4.2.1:18.1: (yathā Āyatanayamakaṃ vibhattaṃ, evaṃ Dhātuyamakam pi vibhajitabbaṃ; sadisaṃ kātabbaṃ.) [Pariññāvāro. ]
